PRE-01.description: Assess readable declared members, parsing settings, required indices and supported profile separately for each dependent family.

LNK-01.description: Resolve the descriptor core ID and extension reference columns; retain the exact member/column pair.

LNK-02.description: One finding per empty or whitespace-only core key, preserving its original text.

LNK-03.description: One finding per exact repeated nonmissing core-key group, retaining all member row locators.

LNK-04.description: One finding per empty or whitespace-only measurement reference.

LNK-05.description: A nonmissing reference with zero exact nonmissing core targets is unresolved.

LNK-06.description: A reference with multiple exact core targets is ambiguous; include all candidate row locators.

LNK-07.description: Summarise measurements per unique nonmissing core key; missing/repeated keys have separate coverage groups.

LNK-08.description: Expose leading/trailing whitespace on nonmissing identifiers without changing exact equality.

TMP-00.description: Resolve readable declared or explicitly confirmed date roles and component assignments; suggestions do not authorise execution.

TMP-01.description: Classify empty or whitespace-only mapped single-field dates as missing.

TMP-02.description: Collect all compatible enabled lexical patterns; documented date order can resolve candidates. No calendar validation.

TMP-03.description: Classify named day/month/year components as missing, incomplete, recognised or unrecognised without assembling a date.

TMP-08.description: Reconcile one status per source row per mapped date field/group; candidate counts are separate from row totals.
